summary: A Toronto boutique brokerage appears to lose seller leads because key menu items go nowhere and there is no valuation form.

findings.problem: The Selling, Buying, About, Featured Listings, Pre-Construction and Education Hub menu items appear to link to #.
findings.cost: Visitors cannot reach the pages that bring in sellers and buyers.
findings.fix: Working pages behind every menu item.

findings.problem: The menu links to What Is Your Property Worth, but no valuation form appears, only a phone number and email.
findings.cost: Owners ready for a valuation have no easy way to ask.

findings.problem: Two different office addresses and phone numbers appear, 15 plus years and 17 plus years appear, and the listing cards appear twice.
findings.cost: Inconsistent details and repeats weaken trust.
findings.fix: One verified set of details and clean listings.

findings.problem: Instagram posts appear to use a placeholder image, and testimonials appear without last names or sale details.
findings.cost: Placeholders and thin proof reduce credibility.
findings.fix: A working feed and detailed testimonials.
